name: vela
description: Compiler-exact code search for Claude Code and Codex - where a symbol is defined, every reference, who calls it, and what a change breaks. It speaks SCIP, so one set of verbs answers across a whole repository: .NET is indexed natively through Roslyn, including the Razor Pages, MVC views and Blazor components that never exist as files on disk, with every reference resolved by the compiler into a saved index, and any other language reaches the same database through its own SCIP indexer. Deterministic: no model calls, no network, and it never modifies the repository it indexes.
